artworks.title: Children Looking over the Edge of a Crib
artworks.medium: black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper bodies of two individuals leaning over the side of a crib-like structure. They are positioned closely together, both gripping the railing with both hands while peering down. The child on the left has hair that is disheveled, while the child on the right has their hair pulled back. The clothing of both individuals seems loose and relaxed, suggested by the flowing lines drawn around them. The foreground contains sketchy lines, possibly depicting a blanket or the drape of the crib. The background is minimal, with just a few faint lines, keeping focus on the two figures.

artworks.title: Le cafe concert des reservistes
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing next to several men in military-style uniforms at a table. The woman has dark hair styled with bangs and an updo, pale complexion with rosy cheeks and red lips. She wears a black off-the-shoulder dress with white detailing and black gloves. One man near her carries a tray with drinks. The background consists of abstract brushstrokes in shades of blue and green, creating an impressionistic feel.

artworks.title: Peur de Bourreau! Qu'est-ce que tu attends?...
artworks.medium: black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a horizontal sketch showing two individuals in a bedroom. One person is lying on the floor, visible from the side with short hair and resting on elbows. The other person is sitting on their knees, holding a stick, also seen from the side with a round face and short hair. Both wear loose clothing. In the background, a bed with a blanket covering an indistinct figure is partially visible along with clothes or fabric under the bed. The sketch is in black and white with emphasis on outlines and shades. The background is bare, and there is text at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: a) Lady and Gentleman in Evening Dress (recto); b) Sketch of Figure (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) pen and black ink on wove paper
b) pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a pencil drawing of two people, with only the upper body and heads visible. One person is seen in profile from the side, standing with their back slightly turned towards the viewer. This person has delicate facial features, with noticeable emphasis on the eye and nose, and their hair is styled in an ornate updo. Their clothing is suggested with a low neckline and an earring adorns the ear. The second person is depicted facing forward, with a mustache and square jawline. Little detail is provided for their attire. The background of the image is mostly bare, with dark shading behind the first person's head.

artworks.title: Farniente
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a watercolor painting of a person from the shoulders up, with a casual approach to defining body parts. The person faces slightly to the side, with a red mouth, softly painted eyes, and a gentle expression. The loose hair flows in light brown tones blending into a plain beige background. Additional details or clothing are not clearly defined, keeping the focus on the upper body and face.

artworks.title: Nude on Rocks
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a nude figure lying on rocks by a shoreline. The composition focuses on a reclining form draped over a smooth surface, surrounded by large, rugged boulders in a natural setting. The color palette is limited to sepia tones, contributing to a monochromatic aesthetic that enhances the texture and form of the rocks. There is a sense of tranquility and harmony within the natural environment, conveyed through the gentle brushstrokes and soft transitions between shadows and highlights.

artworks.title: a) Chauffeur and Procession (recto); b) Two Sketches of Chauffeur and Passenger (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) black crayon on wove paper
b) graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures sitting side by side, looking towards a distant structure resembling a church. The drawing is executed in sketchy pencil strokes, creating an impressionistic and gestural depiction. The figures are outlined in simple, flowing lines, with minimal detail. The distant structure features a cross on its roof and is surrounded by faint indications of trees or buildings on a flat landscape. The overall composition of the drawing directs the viewer's eye from the foreground figures to the background structure.

artworks.title: Marshal Petain
artworks.medium: watercolor and pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person from the waist up. The person is standing upright, looking slightly to their left with a confident posture. They have a distinct facial profile with a noticeable mustache and a bald head. The person is wearing a light-colored buttoned tunic that resembles a uniform. The surroundings depict a barren landscape with sandy or desert-like terrain. To the left, there is another figure, less defined and possibly seated. The background features a dark, swirling cloud-filled sky contrasting with the sandy ground.

artworks.title: a) Ludus pro Populo (recto); b) Head of a Man (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) black crayon on wove paper
b) black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows three full-body figures in a monochromatic style. On the left, a standing woman looks downward towards a seated man in the center, who is hunched over. Beside him is a child, looking at the man's hands which hold an object resembling a plate. The figures are dressed in long, simple garments. The background suggests a sparse room with a possible table. French text is included above and below the figures.

artworks.title: At an Evening Party
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a group of people, including two women and four men. The women are in the center, shown from the waist up, wearing elegant dresses with off-shoulder designs. The men are positioned around them, also shown from the waist up, wearing tuxedos or formal jackets. One man has a mustache. The sketch shows basic outlines of the figures and their clothing, with no visible details of jewelry or objects. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: To Each His Own
artworks.medium: brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures interacting. One figure is standing holding a drink, while another figure is seated and embraced by a third figure. The drawing features minimalistic line work with sparse use of shading to create the figures. The seated figure is being embraced by the third figure. The standing figure holds a shallow glass or coupe. The background is simple, focusing on the interaction among the figures. The style is simplistic and expressive, highlighting human interaction and social nuances.

artworks.title: Sur le canape
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays flowing lines and various shapes loosely arranged in an abstract composition. In the foreground, there are scribbles and lines suggesting the presence of people, with one figure appearing to hold an umbrella. In the background, there are large vertical arcs and irregular shapes resembling arches or architectural structures, along with softer, diffuse strokes that may resemble trees or foliage. This abstract depiction leaves room for viewers to connect with familiar objects like a covered promenade or park setting.

artworks.title: Consolation
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two people in an intimate setting, with most of their upper bodies visible. The man, who is seated, appears to have a bald head and distinct facial features with a solemn expression, while the woman stands close beside him, with long flowing hair and a more subdued facial expression. She seems to be leaning toward him or resting upon him gently. The man is wearing a dark suit with a visible white shirt underneath, while the woman appears to be wearing a long-sleeved garment. The background consists of vertical lines that suggest a curtain or textured surface behind them.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: watercolor, pen and black ink, and graphite on wove J Whatman paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in a seated position with a beard and short hair, partially covered by a wide-brimmed hat. They wear a blue garment in contrast to the green landscape. The background is an impressionistic blend of soft colors, including greens, yellows, and blues, suggesting a natural setting. The loose and flowing brushstrokes in the grass and sky create an impressionistic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Avant la fête persanne
artworks.medium: brush and black ink, wash, and black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of two people from the waist up. The central figure is sitting on a chair, poised with her head slightly tilted. She has delicate facial features, defined hair, and wears an elaborate hat with large feathers. The second figure stands behind her, possibly assisting with the hat or hair, wearing a bonnet. The seated woman wears a light-colored gown with a deep neckline. On the table in front of her are a comb and a framed mirror. The background depicts simple vertical and horizontal lines, suggesting a room with a window.

artworks.title: Two Ladies in a Loge
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two people sketched in a simple line drawing style on beige paper. On the left, a person in profile view is shown with the upper half of their body visible, looking down at their raised hands. The person on the right is seated, facing slightly to the right with a relaxed posture. They have an updo hairstyle and wear a loose-fitting garment, holding three narrow sticks or rods in their right hand. The background is plain with linear patterns suggesting a surface to the right of the person.

artworks.title: Elections Municipales
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with brown and gray wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of two people in an interior setting. On the left, a standing man wearing a long coat and hat is facing towards the other person. He is holding a bag over his shoulder. To the right, a woman is lying in a bed with pillows, wearing a nightcap and nightgown. She has wide eyes and an open mouth. The background is simple. French text is inscribed in the upper and lower portions of the image.

artworks.title: Le Peril Anarchiste
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man holding a child while facing a woman. The man has a beard and short, spiky hair, wearing a long-sleeved shirt and loose-fitting pants. The woman has her back to the viewer, with dark hair pulled back neatly, dressed in a long dress with a lighter apron. The child is wearing a cap and a simple outfit, looking towards the woman. In the background, there is a chair draped with a cloth and a laundry line with clothes and a sock hanging from it. The scene is set in a simple room with minimal furnishings.

artworks.title: Projet de Voyage
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and colored washes on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a barber scene. The drawing depicts one individual trimming another's beard or hair. One figure holds scissors, focused on their task, while the other sits back holding a handheld mirror. Nearby, there is a cup with steam rising, combs, and a small bowl, suggesting a barbershop. The drawing includes signatures, inscriptions, and handwritten text at the bottom. The style features loose lines and washes of color.

artworks.title: Before the Repast at Emmaus
artworks.medium: brush and gray ink with brown and gray wash on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring chairs and tables. The drawing shows indistinct forms of chairs around a table, with light lines and shades hinting at additional furnishings. Ink wash is used for shadow and depth, creating a sense of quietness and minimalism. The absence of fine detail highlights the abstract and contemplative nature of the drawing.

artworks.title: The Adulteress
artworks.medium: pen and brown and grey ink on brown wove paper mounted on board
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures, one of whom is lying on the ground. It depicts a moment of interaction among a group of figures, with one figure gesturing and another figure assisting the person on the ground. The medium is pencil or ink on paper. The background includes architectural elements like arches and steps. The figures are outlined rather than fully detailed, emphasizing their actions and poses. The use of line in the drawing creates a dynamic and fluid representation of the situation.

artworks.title: Men of Justice
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink with brown wash on green laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an ink wash drawing of two figures positioned closely together. The figure on the left is seated with their upper body visible, leaning back with the head tilted upwards. The facial features are lightly sketched, and the hair is short. They wear a dark, flowing garment. The figure on the right leans over a horizontal surface with the head resting on one hand. The facial features are undefined, and they have a bald head. Their clothing is represented with simple lines. The background is a plain, lightly shaded surface.

artworks.title: Defenseur et  Accuse
artworks.medium: crayon with graphite additions on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of four people - three adults and one child. The sketch features the upper bodies of the individuals, who are positioned closely together, appearing to be sitting or reclining on a surface. The central figure, an adult with long dark hair, has a stylized face with exaggerated features. The person to their right, also an adult, has a distinct mustache and similarly stylized facial features. Another adult figure to the left is wearing a hat, with facial features etched in shadows. The child is nestled in the arms of the central figure, wrapped in fabric, with their face partially visible. All figures are wearing loosely sketched garments. In the background, there are linear patterns and abstract shapes suggesting an indoor setting with architectural elements such as shelves or walls. The sketch is monochrome, created with dark lines on sepia-toned paper.

artworks.title: The Supper at Emmaus
artworks.medium: watercolor and colored chalks on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of five people around a table. In the center, two men - one leaning over with his head down, the other supporting his head with a hand. The man leaning over has dark hair, partly visible, and wears a brown garment. Next to them sits another individual with longer hair and a beard, wearing a red robe, looking towards the viewer. To their right, a person stands holding a tray with bread, with short hair and a neatly trimmed beard. Nearby, a child with dark hair and a man at the table wear lighter-colored clothing, with the child partly obscured. In the background, there is a softly lit archway scene with blue and green hues suggesting an outdoor setting. The setting feels intimate, muted by subdued tones and gentle light, creating a blend of warmth and shadow.
